# Windows-only test deselections for CI (SPEC.md 6.2, ROADMAP theme T2).
#
# One line per pytest node ID; # comments allowed. Every entry must have a
# GitHub issue tracking the underlying Windows defect — the entry is removed
# when the fix lands. Never add anything here that is not a hard process
# crash (access violation / segfault): ordinary failures fix forward.

tests/test_text.py::test_a_read_only_input_refuses_every_keyboard_edit

# Same family as the entry above (#5): synthetic events against a
# read-only text input, access violation. Crashed on the [box] param
# (run 34918702144); the other params die behind it, so the whole test
# (all params) is deselected until #5's root cause is fixed.
tests/test_text.py::test_a_read_only_input_still_selects_and_copies

# mpv render-context teardown race: Root.destroy() while libmpv's event
# thread still holds the window -> code 0xe24c4a02 (D3D11 device removed),
# process death. Crash sits at the media_display -> media_player boundary
# with MPVEventHandlerThread alive (run 34915085020). Whole file deselected
# until the shutdown ordering is fixed; test_video_display.py and the video
# paths of test_composite_events.py / test_nametowrapper.py /
# test_traversal.py are suspects for the same race.
tests/test_media_player.py
